notes: A plain OTA update is enough — panic_info included — crashes are captured in RTC memory, which needs no partition, so nothing has to be flashed over USB.

Optional: flashing partition-table_<ver>.bin at 0x8000 over USB once adds the coredump partition, which upgrades panic_info with a full backtrace; the layout only gains partitions at the end, so NVS (WiFi credentials, settings) and the installed app are kept — unlike _full.bin, which would wipe them.
[Diag] Panics are captured without needing any partition
[OTA] Update straight from the firmware hub
[Release] The hub sync now also writes firmware/domikautoslave/latest.json
[Build] CI built against the wrong partition table
